description: Average (median) last spring frost date and first fall frost date for a US ZIP code, a place name or coordinates, the dates beaten in only 1 year in 10, the earliest and latest on record, the median frost-free growing season, and the last spring and first fall frost of the latest seasons. Computed from 30 complete seasons of daily minimum temperatures. threshold_f 32 (frost, default), 36 (light frost on tender plants) or 28 (hard freeze).

location.description: A US ZIP code ("80202"), a place ("Burlington, VT", "Leeds, UK") or "lat,lon". Add the state or country to a place name to avoid a same-named town.

name: frost_dates
title: Last frost and first frost dates
